response:
It sounds like you're carrying a lot of emotional pain, and I want you to know that you deserve support. What you're describing—self-harm, intense reactions to memories, fear of abandonment, and feeling overwhelmed in public—can feel exhausting and isolating, but you don't have to face it alone.

Because you mentioned hitting yourself and pulling your hair, I want to gently encourage you to reach out for help. Consider contacting a mental health professional who can help you understand these patterns and develop coping strategies. If you're in crisis or worried about your safety, please reach out to a crisis line like 988 (in the US) or emergency services. You can also talk to someone you trust about what you're experiencing.

Your feelings are valid, and struggling doesn't make you "too much" or unworthy of care. Healing is possible with the right support.
